headline: On November 2, 1988: Morris worm launched from MIT
captionCards: First felony conviction under 1986 Computer Fraud and Abuse Act
instagramCaption:
Robert Tappan Morris launches the first Internet-distributed computer worm.\n \\The Morris worm, a self-replicating program, affected VAX computers and SUN-3 workstations running Berkeley UNIX. Launched from the MIT network at 8:30 p.m., it caused significant disruption and gained widespread media attention. This incident led to the first felony conviction under the 1986 Computer Fraud and Abuse Act. The Morris worm highlighted the vulnerabilities of early internet infrastructure and the need for cybersecurity. \\Why do you think this event was so pivotal in the history of the internet? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
